description: Live E2E for the Animation RQL module. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py (scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (adapters, validation, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its adapter descriptions). The 'tools' then run every AnimationGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-backs and two rejected values (a dry-run set, and a call that must fail before it changes anything). 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated, and a call receipt ends in '|<result>'.

input.query: nodes | where name == "Player" | get libraries[""] | call CreateAnimation("Idle", 2, "linear")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call AddTrack("value", "Mover:position:x")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call InsertKey(0, 0.5, 1.5)
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call AddTrack("rotation-3d", "Mover")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call InsertTransformKey(1, 1, "(0, 90, 0)")
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | set Length = 1.5, LoopMode = "Pingpong"
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"].tracks | select index kind path keyCount
nodes | where $ is AnimationPlayer | select name animations.keys() libraries.keys()
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | select Length LoopMode trackCount
nodes | where name == "Player" | get libraries["Extra"].animations["Walk"] | select Length LoopMode trackCount
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | set Length = 0

expect: Length must be a number of seconds of at least 0.001

input.query: nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | call InsertKey(5, 0, 1)
nodes | where name == "Player" | get animations["Idle"] | select trackCount tracks[0].keyCount
